title: Section 35A — Compensatory costs for false or vexatious claims or defences — CPC 1908

content.heading: Compensatory costs for false or vexatious claims or defences
content.text: If in any suit or other proceedings, including an execution proceeding but excluding an appeal or a revision, any party objects to the claim or defence on the ground that it is false or vexatious to the knowledge of the party making it, and if such claim or defence is disallowed, abandoned or withdrawn in whole or in part, the Court, if it is satisfied that the claim or defence was false or vexatious to the knowledge of that party, may, after recording its reasons, make an order for the payment to the objector of costs by way of compensation. Read the official ceiling and conditions.
